description: Vehicle 1 goes straight through an intersection. Vehicle 2 is traveling in the same direction as Vehicle 1 and starts in front of Vehicle 1 in the same lane on Vehicle 1’s approach road. Vehicle 3 is traveling in the same direction as Vehicle 1 and starts between Vehicle 1 and Vehicle 2 in the adjacent lane. On Vehicle 1’s exit road, first there are 3 cones near the center of Vehicle 1’s lane, and then farther down the exit road a pedestrian crosses perpendicularly from the right edge to the left edge of the road.
